about_the_game:
Veil Walker is an Action Role Playing Game, where you can play solo or team up with other players.

Veil Walker takes place in a land where a rift between realms has fractured the veil of reality, spilling forth a malevolent force. This volatile energy seeps into living creatures, warping their minds, removing any semblance of their former selves.

As a Veil Walker, you are one of the few chosen who can traverse the shifting boundaries between worlds without succumbing to the corruption. It is your duty to hunt down and purge the corrupted. With every successful culling, you increase your own skills and abilities, enhancing your strength and resilience. However beware, each time the Rift surges anew, stronger and more cunning creatures emerge, testing your resolve and strength. The only path forward is to master your growing power, hunt down the corrupted, and bring balance back to a world teetering on the edge of ruin.

Key Features

  • Procedural Generated Maps

Hunt across a unique map every time, utilising a procedural generated tile system so that no session will be the same. At the same time, you are in control of the difficulty. Either challenge yourself to target areas of greater corruption, with stronger Hosts and creatures, or scale it back to whatever feels comfortable. 

  • Gear

Discover and experiment with a vast arsenal of powerful weapons, armor and more to fight back against the corruption threatening the land. Explore unique combinations, and equip upgrades and powerful tools to battle back against powerful foes. 

  • Skill Tree and Abilities

Create and customize your character to face the encroaching corruption. Choose how your character develops via selection of skills and abilities, creating a Veil Walker that is uniquely your own. Grow stronger as you progress through powerful Skill Trees.
